catalysts.headline: Nasdaq notified Beneficient that the market value of its listed securities has been below the $35 million minimum required for continued listing for 30 consecutive business days

Nasdaq's Listing Qualifications Department notified Beneficient that the market value of its listed securities had been below the $35 million Nasdaq Capital Market minimum for 30 consecutive business days (Sept 24 - Nov 4, 2026); the company also fails Nasdaq's alternative stockholders'-equity and net-income standards.
catalysts.impact: No immediate effect on listing -- BENF/BENFW continue trading as-is. Per the Q3 FY2026 10-Q, the company has until 2027-05-04 to regain compliance; missing that deadline would be expected to trigger a Nasdaq delisting notice, appealable to a Hearings Panel.

catalysts.headline: Bradley Heppner's criminal sentencing hearing (SDNY) rescheduled

Bradley Heppner's criminal sentencing hearing (SDNY) has reportedly been rescheduled to January 11, 2027. This is a single-source report (Panabee); no second independent outlet or court-docket confirmation was found this session, and it supersedes the prior 'adjourned, no new date set' status on file (as of 2026-10-22).

Shareholders approved the issuance of Class A common stock to Yorkville II PN, Ltd. at a special meeting; former controlling entity BHI had alleged irregularities in the issuance, which management rejected in full
catalysts.impact: Clears a financing-related governance dispute; does not resolve the broader ~$130M HCLP Nominees debt dispute already on file

catalysts.headline: Beneficient corporate update confirms Bradley Heppner's criminal sentencing has been rescheduled to January 11, 2027 (previously adjourned without a date after his original Oct 7, 2026 date fell through); company reiterated it is still pursuing its strategy to eliminate ~$130M in disputed HCLP Nominees debt and separately is seeking to recover ~$211M previously paid on HCLP-related obligations

Beneficient reportedly filed a motion to intervene in existing litigation seeking to recover approximately $211 million previously paid on HCLP-related obligations, alongside its ongoing strategy (on file from 2026-09-23) to void ~$130M in disputed HCLP Nominees debt.

catalysts.headline: A Southern District of New York spokesperson confirmed Bradley Heppner's criminal sentencing 'was adjourned without a new date' — as of this date, NO new sentencing date has been set. Judge Rakoff approved Heppner's removal of his former Quinn Emanuel attorneys; he has retained new counsel (Alexandra Shapiro, Jonathan Bach, consistent with on-file info) and reportedly plans to appeal.
catalysts.source: InvestmentNews, 'GWG's Heppner hires Puff Daddy's attorneys as criminal sentencing looms', dated 2026-10-22

catalysts.headline: 8-K filed disclosing a debt-letter-agreement amendment, effective 2026-10-07, between Beneficient and HH-BDH that pushed back a $1,000,000 cash-payment deadline owed to HH-BDH to March 31, 2027.

catalysts.headline: Beneficient announces a strategy to eliminate ~$130M in disputed HCLP Nominees debt and void Bradley Heppner's Class B equity/voting/board-appointment rights; plan would also convert ~$850M in preferred liquidation preference into ~162,132 Class A shares and void ~$88M of other obligations owed to Heppner/affiliates

catalysts.headline: Manhattan federal jury convicts Beneficient/GWG Holdings founder Bradley Heppner on all four counts: securities fraud, wire fraud, conspiracy, and making false statements to auditors
A Manhattan federal jury convicts Bradley Heppner (Beneficient/GWG Holdings founder) on all four counts: securities fraud, wire fraud, conspiracy, and false statements to auditors
